meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按语法结构定位并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要按语法结构跨文件搜索和改写代码,而非靠纯文本匹配。
copy.tagline_en: Locate and batch-rewrite code by its syntax shape.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and transform code structures across many files, not just exact string matches.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按代码的语法结构（而不是纯文本）搜索和改写代码：能找出形状相同的函数、调用、类等写法，把一种代码形式批量改成另一种，支持约 25 种语言。
howto.when: 当你提出的需求取决于代码形状而不只是文本内容时触发，例如按形状找函数/调用/类、做批量改写、运行 YAML 规则；找字符串、注释或文件名应改用 rg。

say.text: 找出所有带 Request 参数类型的函数。
say.note: 按代码结构搜索，结果会列出文件与位置。

say.text: 运行我们的 YAML 规则，列出违规点。
say.note: 调用 scan 子命令，输出规则报告。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude searches and rewrites code by syntax structure (AST) instead of raw text. It can find every function/call/class/import with a given shape and apply batch rewrites across about 25 languages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the task depends on code structure, not text bytes—e.g. finding structurally identical functions/calls/classes, running codemods or rewrites, or applying YAML rules. Use rg for plain strings, comments, or filenames.

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter.
say_en.note: Runs an AST search and lists matches.

say_en.text: Rewrite console.log(x) to logger.info(x) across the repo.
say_en.note: Shows a dry-run preview; applies only after confirmation.

say_en.text: Run our YAML rules and report violations.
